data.one_liner: Atomic state management solution for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: ASP (Atomic State Pattern) offers a state management system for Flutter based on atoms, actions, and selectors. It uses hook_state for state distribution and provides tracking for state changes.
use_when: You want a functional, atomic approach to state management in Flutter
You want to track which actions modified specific atoms for debugging
You prefer hooks for state distribution over traditional builders
avoid_when: You prefer class-based state management patterns like Bloc
You rely on pre-built reactive collections like RxList or RxMap which were removed in v2
strengths: Simplified and predictable state management API
Detailed observability on state changes and triggering actions
Functional approach with lowercase atom creation
weaknesses: Removed built-in reactive collections (RxList, RxSet, RxMap) in v2
Breaking changes between v1 and v2 require migration effort
